summary: EquipmentShare.com Inc filed an 8-K disclosing the closing of a private offering of $1,350 million aggregate principal amount of 7.125% senior secured second lien notes due 2034. The notes were issued at par under an indenture with Citibank as trustee and collateral agent. Interest is payable semi-annually, with make-whole redemption provisions and a 101% change-of-control put. No subsidiary guarantees were provided. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation. No deal terms are applicable because this is not a change-of-control or equity transaction.
